messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front styling and the back view for the back styling. Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color, identity, and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman looks at the camera, then lowers her head and raises her right hand to brush her hair back and touch the side of her head before turning her back to the camera and then turning back to face forward.","camera":"Static, eye-level medium close-up shot from a first-person perspective.","clothing":"A bright pink, long-sleeved off-the-shoulder top with purple ribbon ties at the shoulders.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair styled in a sleek bob with a side part and a distinct side-swept section across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with fair skin, dark eyes, and a small mole on her left cheek.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit industrial or dockyard area with stone paving, wooden planks, a large wooden boat hull on the left, and rusted metal structures in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's blue bob with side buns was replaced by a short black updo/bob with a side-swept front section and a gathered back, matching the reference hairstyle structure. The face, pink top, scene, camera, and motion remained largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, transferring only shape/structure while preserving the original hair color, identity, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the back styling fully matches the reference updo from all angles.
unexpected_changes: Hair color changed from blue to black, contrary to the instruction to preserve the original hair color.
